title: Half Past One
overview: Between every drunken confession or dazed quarrel, parties create the sparkling backdrop to many heated conversations. HALF PAST ONE follows Leah and Aggie and their relationship's journey. Told in non-linear fragments, Aggie navigates her need to belong while Leah spirals out of control. That is, until Aggie stumbles across nonchalant Jo, forcing her to reconsider what she really wants.
